name: E0_1_acam_magnitude
title: Magnitude probe: can a PCM analog CAM serve tree-based inference, does drift break it, and do tracking or ratio thresholds rescue it?
deviations: 1.1 (2026-10-12 16:52 JST, before any full-run outcome): check 2 originally compared the 30-bit-threshold CAM with sklearn and failed on digits (0.9963, run E0_1_20261012_1650 stopped by the check). Cause: digits features are discrete, so test values can lie exactly on a split threshold (e.g. 0.875 = midpoint of the training values 0.8125 and 0.9375 in a node), and the (2^30 - 1) grid moves such a threshold by about 1e-10, flipping x <= thr. The CAM with float64 thresholds agrees 100 %. Check 2 now uses float64 thresholds; plan 1.0 config sha256 83ace66b9f75ae0a1e9cc3f239a53eedcb6dd633dc2576229b4ce896f5c8ddbd. No model, scheme, metric or decision setting changed.

questions.A_viability: With programming noise only (t0), is a PCM analog CAM close to the ideal quantized CAM?
questions.B_problem: Without drift tracking, does the accuracy collapse within a day?
questions.C_solution: Does global drift tracking or a ratio threshold keep the accuracy close to the ideal for 30 days?

pcm_model.source: AIHWKit PCMLikeNoiseModel (IBM/aihwkit master, read 2026-10-12); Nandakumar et al., ICECS 2019, IEEE Xplore 8964852

cam_model.cell: two bounds per feature per row (lower: match if x > theta_L; upper: match if x <= theta_U), the semantics of the sklearn split x <= thr; wildcard (unconstrained) bounds always match
cam_model.threshold_mapping: each bound is set by a memristor-transistor voltage divider; to first order the threshold voltage is affine in the device conductance and both bounds increase with conductance (Li et al. 2020 / Pedretti et al. 2021 6T2M cell, linear conduction at low voltage); the input DAC maps the normalized feature x in [0, 1] onto that affine range
cam_model.matching: row matches if all its constrained bounds are satisfied; forest score = sum over matching rows of the leaf class-probability vector; prediction = argmax of the score, and a sample with no matching row in any tree counts as wrong
cam_model.inputs: features min-max normalized on the training split, test features clipped to [0, 1], applied as continuous values (no input DAC quantization)

V2_abs_high.note: g_lo = 25 uS * exp(-(0.008 + 0.0059)/0.0125), the conductance above which the AIHWKit drift spread is at its floor

V3_ratio.note: G1 = r g_sum, G2 = (1 - r) g_sum, theta = (G1/(G1 + G2) - r_lo)/(r_hi - r_lo); mean drift cancels by construction

V2d_abs_high_dual.note: secondary: two parallel devices programmed to the same target, threshold from their mean

tracking.replica: a_hat(t) = mean of 64 replica cells at the middle of the absolute range at t (with their own programming, drift and read noise) / their mean right after programming

datasets.synthetic: sklearn make_classification(n_samples=5000, n_features=20, n_informative=10, n_redundant=4, n_classes=4, n_clusters_per_class=2, class_sep=1.0, random_state=20261012)

model: sklearn RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=16, max_depth=6, random_state=split_seed); stratified 70/30 split with random_state=split_seed

metrics.acc_ref: accuracy of the ideal quantized CAM (no device noise) for the same dataset, split and bit width
metrics.loss: acc_ref - accuracy, in percentage points; averaged over split seeds and device seeds per dataset
metrics.mean_loss: mean of the per-dataset losses over the 5 datasets
metrics.conditions: prog: programming noise only at t0; all@t: programming noise, drift and accumulated read noise at t (AIHWKit semantics, read noise present already at t0)
metrics.path_integrity: share of (sample, tree) pairs with exactly one matching row

decision.gate_A: PASS if some scheme in {V1_abs_full, V2_abs_high, V3_ratio} has mean_loss(prog) <= 2.0 pp and max_loss(prog) <= 5.0 pp
decision.gate_B: PASS if, for the absolute scheme (V1 or V2) with the smaller mean_loss(prog), the untracked mean_loss(all@1d) >= 10.0 pp
decision.gate_C: PASS if some scheme in {V1_abs_full + replica, V2_abs_high + replica, V3_ratio} that meets the gate-A criteria has mean_loss(all@30d) <= 5.0 pp
decision.verdict: GO only if A, B and C all pass; otherwise NO_GO with the failing gates named
decision.secondary: 3 and 5 bits, the dual-device scheme, 1-year losses, per-dataset losses and path integrity are reported but do not change the verdict

checks.check_1_cam_equals_quantized_tree_traver: predictions identical and exactly one match per tree for every test sample (all datasets, split 0, 4 bits)
checks.check_2_float_thresholds_equal_sklearn: with unquantized (float64) thresholds the ideal CAM prediction equals sklearn predict for at least 99.9 % of test samples (all datasets, split 0); the 30-bit agreement and the number of exact value-threshold ties are reported for information only
checks.check_4_tracking_exact_without_spread: with programming and read noise off and the drift spread set to 0, V2 + replica and V3 reproduce the quantized thresholds to 1e-12 at every time

not_modelled: transistor nonlinearity, threshold-voltage variation and mismatch of the cell transistors
wildcard bounds are assumed robust (bypassed), i.e. they never cause a mismatch
